notes: The variant unit covering s016 carries the base reading, which the ASV's 'their' realizes.
'Διὰ τί' -> 'Why' is rule 45's named case, one noncompositional unit headed on the governed τί.
οὐ is an ordinary negative: no negative indefinite follows, so rules 41 and 59 do not reach it.
Both articles governing possessed nouns are unrepresented under rule 20 proper, σου and αὐτῶν each being present and free to take the possessive.
